name: CETC Chips Technology Inc.
summary: CETC Chips Technology Inc. engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, testing, and sale of silicon-based analog semiconductor chips and related application products in China and internationally. It operates through Integrated Circuit Division and Power Supply Division segments.
